title: Journey registry row
description: An entry of the journey hierarchy: experience domain (L0, DOM), lifecycle (L1, LFC) or journey (L2, JRN). L3/L4 are nodes and live in the node register. One CSV row is one JSON object keyed by column header; an empty cell means 'not yet known' and is omitted from the object, so 'required' means the cell must be filled. List-valued cells hold IDs separated by ';' with no spaces. Required: journey_id, level and name (identity and place in the hierarchy), state and status (without them current, target and transitional versions and the lifecycle cannot be told apart). parent_id is empty for DOM rows and for journeys not yet placed in the hierarchy, and actor_id may be empty only for DOM rows (the validator enforces it for LFC and JRN), so both are optional here; baseline_journey_id is required only for L2 target or transitional journeys, a conditional rule the validator enforces; boundaries, outcome, owner, version and review date are the content a draft is still gathering.

parent_id.description: Hierarchy entry one or more levels up (DOM or LFC).

baseline_journey_id.description: Current L2 journey that this target or transitional journey changes; empty for current journeys and for L0/L1 entries.
